Inherited, thickened heart muscle and symptoms (breathlessness, fatigue, arrhythmia) are standard HCM facts; the FDA page's exact wording was not visible in retrieved extracts, so the 'It describes' attribution is unverified.
claims.fix: Obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy is an inherited condition that thickens the heart muscle; symptoms can include shortness of breath, fatigue and an abnormal heart rhythm that can be life-threatening.

claims.evidence: FDA: SCOUT-HCM, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 44 patients aged 12-18, 28 weeks; Camzyos significantly reduced the Valsalva LVOT gradient versus placebo.
FDA: adults showed similar LVOT obstruction reduction with improved function; expected to improve functional capacity and symptoms in paediatric patients weighing at least 30 kg.
FDA text: boxed warning for risk of heart failure; only available through the Camzyos REMS.
